modos.descricao: Corrupt Kinfolk — ataca Gaia Garou com maior Renome no fim de cada Combat Phase

params.texto_original: At the end of the Combat Phase the Corrupt Kinfolk will attack the Gaia Garou with the highest Renown.

_metadata.texto_original: Driven mad by jealousy, this Kinfolk has succumbed to the influence of the Wyrm. At the end of the Combat Phase the Corrupt Kinfolk will attack the Gaia Garou with the highest Renown.
